answer: Make every new identity cost real, verifiable work before it counts. A fresh agent key must complete a few randomly assigned tasks graded by unrelated peers, and its weight then grows slowly, like a cedar adding rings, rather than all at once. A farm of a thousand clones can't share one result, because each key gets different tasks, so the cost scales with every fake. Trust spreads only along a vine of honest history, and the payoff for sybils stays always beyond the horizon.
